Constant token symbol string 'XBTC'.
Constant token decimals value 18.
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance, mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Total token supply storage variable totalSupply_.
Constructor that overrides the passed total with a hardcoded 4000000000000000000000000 and mints it to msg.sender.
View function returning totalSupply_.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers numTokens from msg.sender to receiver using SafeMath sub/add.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][delegate] to numTokens.
View function returning allowed[owner][delegate].
Spends allowance to move tokens from owner to buyer using SafeMath sub/add.
SafeMath.sub library function performing a - b with assert guard.
SafeMath.add library function performing a + b with assert guard.
msg.sender used as minter, transfer origin, approval owner and spender.
balances[msg.sender].sub(numTokens) arithmetic mutation inside transfer.
balances[receiver].add(numTokens) arithmetic mutation inside transfer.
balances[owner].sub(numTokens) arithmetic mutation inside transferFrom.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter total is read and then discarded in favour of a hardcoded supply value.
msg.sender is used as the recipient of the initial minted supply in the constructor.
Constructor writes the initial value into totalSupply_.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
totalSupply() returns the totalSupply_ state variable.
balanceOf reads its tokenOwner parameter as mapping key.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads balances of msg.sender and receiver.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and receiver.
transfer uses numTokens parameter as the amount to move.
transfer uses receiver parameter as destination address.
transfer authorises the debit using msg.sender.
transfer invokes the SafeMath sub operation on the sender balance.
numTokens feeds the subtraction from the sender balance.
Sender balance from balances mapping is the minuend of the subtraction.
Subtraction result is written back into the balances mapping.
transfer invokes the SafeMath add operation on the receiver balance.
numTokens feeds the addition to the receiver balance.
Receiver balance from balances mapping is the first addend.
Addition result is written back into the balances mapping.
approve uses delegate parameter as the spender key.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
allowance reads owner parameter as first mapping key.
allowance reads delegate parameter as second mapping key.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses owner parameter as the debited account.
transferFrom uses buyer parameter as the credited account.
transferFrom uses numTokens parameter as the amount to move.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is checked and reduced.
transferFrom reads balances of owner and buyer.
transferFrom reads the allowed mapping for the spender allowance.
transferFrom writes updated balances for owner and buyer.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back into allowed.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath sub on the owner balance.
Owner balance is the minuend of the subtraction.
numTokens is the subtrahend of the owner balance subtraction.
Subtraction result is stored back into balances.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath sub on the spender allowance.
Current allowance is the minuend of the subtraction.
numTokens is the subtrahend of the allowance subtraction.
Subtraction result is stored back into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath add on the buyer balance.
Buyer balance is the first addend of the addition.
numTokens is the second addend of the addition.
Addition result is stored back into balances.
SafeMath.sub reads parameter a as minuend.
SafeMath.sub reads parameter b as subtrahend and assert bound.
SafeMath.add reads parameter a as first addend.
SafeMath.add reads parameter b as second addend and assert bound.
SafeMath.add computes the sum into local variable c.
transfer calls the SafeMath.sub library function.
transfer calls the SafeMath.add library function.
transferFrom calls the SafeMath.sub library function twice.
transferFrom calls the SafeMath.add library function.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter total only exists in the constructor signature and its value is overwritten by the hardcoded supply.
tokenOwner is a pure lookup key used only by balanceOf.
receiver is consumed only as the destination of the transfer.
numTokens is the direct operand of the SafeMath sub/add balance mutations in transfer.
delegate is only used as the allowance spender key in approve.
owner is only used as the first key of the allowance lookup.
delegate is only used as the second key of the allowance lookup.
owner is only used as the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
buyer is only used as the credited account in transferFrom.
numTokens is the direct operand of the SafeMath sub/add mutations in transferFrom.
a is the minuend consumed solely by the SafeMath sub routine.
b is the subtrahend and assert bound consumed solely by the SafeMath sub routine.
a is the first addend consumed solely by the SafeMath add routine.
b is the second addend and assert bound consumed solely by the SafeMath add routine.
Local c is a transient sum buffer entirely internal to SafeMath add.
